[[File:PokémonWCS2023.png|thumb|250px|The girl reaching out to grab {{p|Pikachu}} with her friends]] '''Challenge the World!''' (Japanese: '''キミに会えた！''' ''I Met You!'') is an {{pkmn|animation|animated}} commercial promoting the [[2023 Pokémon World Championships]], taking place in {{wp|Yokohama|Yokohama, Japan}}. The commercial was released on the Japanese Pokémon [[YouTube]] channel on July 22, 2023, on the Western Pokémon YouTube channels a day later on July 23, 2023, on the Asian Pokémon YouTube channels on July 28, 2023, and on the Korean Pokémon YouTube channel on August 4, 2023. ==Plot== A girl holding a {{p|Pikachu}} plush toy flies into Yokohama, Japan to compete in the 2023 Pokémon World Championships. After making a video call to her friends and fellow players who are also attending the event, she enters the {{wp|Pacifico Yokohama}} convention center with her friends awaiting her near the entrance. As they head inside, {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} begin to appear around the venue. Each of the girl's friends are competing in a different event at the 2023 Pokémon World Championships. The first to play is competing in the 2023 {{g|GO}} World Championships. As he steps onto the stage, the area appears to transition into a grassy meadow. The boy begins the match with his {{form|Shaymin|Sky Forme}} {{p|Shaymin}} and has it use a {{t|Grass}}-type attack against his opponent's {{p|Gholdengo}}. Gholdengo retaliates with a [[Move#Pok.C3.A9mon_GO|Charged Attack]], launching coins at the boy's {{p|Melmetal}}, who uses a [[Trainer_Battle_(GO)#Protect_Shield|Protect Shield]] to negate the attack. The opponent then has his [[Salamence]] use its Charged Attack {{m|Draco Meteor}} against Melmetal just as it readies a {{m|Double Iron Bash}}. The scene then cuts to the 2023 {{g|Trading Card Game}} World Championships, where another one of the girl's friends is competing. After a {{p|Chansey}} [[Coin (TCG)|coin]] is flipped to determine the players' turn order, she reveals her [[Lugia V (Silver Tempest 138)|Lugia V]] card. The competitors' surroundings transition once again, this time to a jungle flooded with water, and the Pokémon cards appear as tangible Pokémon. {{p|Lugia}} appears behind the girl while her {{p|Archeops}} flies out to confront the opponent's {{p|Flaaffy}}. The opponent commands her {{p|Miraidon}} to attack, and it unleashes a blast of purple energy. Lugia retaliates with an equivalent blue blast, and their powerful moves collide before the scene cuts away again. At the 2023 {{g|UNITE}} World Championships, a 5-on-5 match is played on [[Theia Sky Ruins]] with {{UNITE|Mew}}, {{UNITE|Comfey}}, {{UNITE|Tsareena}}, {{UNITE|Dodrio}} and {{UNITE|Greninja}} against {{UNITE|Hoopa}}, {{UNITE|Sableye}}, {{UNITE|Cinderace}}, {{UNITE|Aegislash}} and {{UNITE|Lucario}}. The girl's next friend is commanding Greninja. The Greninja is wearing {{DL|Greninja (UNITE)|Holowear|Wanderer Style}} [[Holowear]] as it faces the Lucario wearing {{DL|Lucario (UNITE)|Holowear|Costume Party Style}}, but both sets of clothes dematerialize before the battle starts. Mew charges up a green ball of energy that's then kicked by Tsareena, launching it into the opposing Aegislash. The opposing team's Cinderace and Lucario retaliate, working together to fire off a {{m|Pyro Ball}} and {{DL|Lucario (UNITE)|Unite Move|Aura Cannon}} at Greninja, who dispels both attacks. Comfey attaches itself to Greninja, and the two ride Greninja's {{DL|Greninja (UNITE)|Unite Move|Waterburst Shuriken}} to the opposing team's [[goal zone]]. Greninja grabs a bundle of [[Aeos energy]] while traveling, then scores in the goal zone. The scene cuts a final time to the 2023 Video Game World Championships, played in {{g|Scarlet and Violet}}. The girl runs onto the stage, and the background transitions to the [[Mesagoza#Places_of_interest|academy]]'s schoolyard. She sends out her {{p|Dragonite}} and {{p|Meowscarada}}, housed in a [[Friend Ball]] and [[Poké Ball (item)|Poké Ball]] respectively. Her opponent sends out his {{p|Iron Bundle}} from its [[Dusk Ball]] and {{p|Dondozo}} from its [[Dive Ball]], and the battle begins. Dondozo fires an attack at Meowscarada that it avoids, and the latter retaliates by using {{m|Flower Trick}}. Iron Bundle then uses {{m|Icy Wind}}, but the girl {{Tera}}stallizes her Dragonite into a {{type|Normal}}, removing its weakness to {{type|Ice}} moves. The Dragonite responds in turn with {{m|Hyper Beam}}. The girl wins the match and her friends arrive to congratulate her on the victory as she throws her Pikachu plush into the air in celebration. Some time later, the group heads outside the convention center, just as a Pikachu falls from the sky in the same manner that her plush did. She reaches out to grab it, with her friends by her side. ===Pokémon===
